description: List the API key owner's open security findings across all scans. Use this to answer "what's my current exposure?" Filter by severity, status, or domain. Returns finding summaries; call get_scan for full detail. Requires API key.

domain.description: Limit to a single domain (e.g., app.example.com)

severity.description: Comma-separated severities to include: critical, high, medium, low, info

name: list_my_findings
